description: Strade is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. L’Area Infrastrutture si è concentrata sull’elaborazione di una rete stradale unica della CMM: ogni valutazione di tipo manutentivo, programmatorio e gestionale non poteva prescindere da una base univoca e formalizzata relativa alla rete stradale di competenza dell’Ente. Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal lists 14 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are infrastrutture, regionale, reti-di-trasporto, strade, strade-provinciale. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
